raw_response:
I managed to get fertilizer coupons through the FISP program this year, so I will apply both NPK and urea to my maize plot because the soil here in Mzimba needs it and I want a good harvest. I also have some cow manure from our animals that I will spread to help the soil. I will plant hybrid maize seed since it came with the subsidy, and my family will do all the weeding and harvesting ourselves since we cannot afford to pay workers. We rely on the rains and do not use chemicals for pests because that costs too much for food crops.
